general_prompt: Two men are participating in a religious hand-washing ceremony together.

detailed_caption_list: The priest in white ceremonial robes is performing the hand-washing ritual on the left, facing right toward the assistant. In a three-quarter view with shoulders angled to the right, he holds his hands over the basin to be washed, watching water run across his palms as fine droplets catch colored light from the stained glass.

The assistant in black is pouring water to assist the rite on the right, facing left toward the priest. Close to the camera in a slight over-the-shoulder angle, they tip a polished jug so the stream falls into the basin over his hands, while their other hand steadies the basin, leaning forward to guide the flow accurately.
